thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: detected service-level latency spike on canary slice after today's release. 15% traffic affected. Alert: 3xx/5xx stable but p50->p95 jump. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/rls/78321

alex: seeing p95 go from 180ms to 2.1s on the canary pool. throughput steady, errors low. kernel fallback traces in logs around 10:05 UTC.

priya: confirmed - traces show kernel selection falling back to 'compat-cpu' for ~30% of requests. suspect the routing change we pushed in release-v23.

jordan: rolling canary at 15% started 10:00 UTC. I can cut traffic if we want to contain. :hand:

ops-liz: customer impact check: payments-api latency up for a small subset, Support reported 4 customers complaining about slow checkout. No widespread failures yet.

alex: quick mitigation proposal: (1) flip feature flag routing-v2 -> off (2) remove canary traffic split -> 0% (3) enable kernel affinity fallback disable to force previous selector.

priya: agreed. doing 1 and 2 now.

deploy-bot: Feature flag update accepted: routing-v2=off by priya at 7832101302. Canary traffic reduced to 0% at 7832101310.

jordan: after flag flip, p95 dropped to ~340ms within two minutes on most nodes. Still some outliers ~1.5s.

alex: digging into logs — batcher logs show microbatch windows shrinking and then growing, causing uneven batching. stack snippet: ```[batcher] window_ms: 6 -> 120 -> 6; kernel: fallback to compat-cpu; kv-hit: 87%```

ops-liz: I opened a short customer note template for impacted accounts. We should include that we rolled back canary and are investigating root cause.

priya: follow-up: there's an interaction between the new routing policy and kernel-selector heuristics that makes some long-sequence requests choose a non-optimized path. Repro locally with seq_len=1024 + routing-v2 enabled.

alex: next actions: (A) rollback release-v23 on canary nodes (B) add tight kill-switch on routing-v2 in orchestration (C) schedule postmortem. Jordan can you run rollback?

jordan: running rollback on canary hosts now. command: ```orchestrator rollback --service=runtime --to-tag=release-v22 --scope=canary```

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by jordan at 7832101405. Progress: 6/8 canary instances rolled back.

alex: monitoring. p95 converging to baseline. kernel selection back to optimized kernels. batcher window stabilized.

ops-liz: customer note sent to 4 impacted accounts. CS will follow up.

priya: marking incident for paging rotation and on-call handoff to eng-runtime for deep dive. tagging owners for kernel-selector and routing.

alex: FYI on postmortem scope: interaction test coverage gap for routing changes with long-sequence traffic; missing explicit kernel affinity tests.

jordan: handing off to eng-runtime oncall @alex and @priya. Oncall next: please coordinate with infra to add a hard kill-switch in rollout pipeline to auto-cut canary traffic on p95>500ms for >2mins.

incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Severity: Sev3. Start 7832101234, mitigated 7832101420. Please fill incident form: https://incidents.redwood/new/7832101234

ops-liz: adding timeline notes and customer impact summary. will ping when postmortem doc is live. :white_check_mark:

alex: thanks everyone. will follow up with RCA and remediation tickets tomorrow.
